Oracle red-swept on main: loop.test.ts has 0 configPath occurrences today. [oracle: grep -q "'configPath' in overrides" test/supervisor/loop.test.ts]

Every test that runs inside a chdir helper (withCodexBackendCwd at the loop.test.ts:172 and :4251 regions, withClaudeImplementerCwd) opts out with an explicit configPath: undefined so it keeps covering the live cwd-default path on purpose (issue AC4). [oracle: grep -q 'configPath: undefined' test/supervisor/loop.test.ts]

The stale non-injectability comments at loop.test.ts:539 and :4246 are rewritten: the replacement wording contains the literal token 'fixture-injectable' (e.g. 'fixture-injectable via RunSupervisorOptions.configPath (CAM-420)') and does not reintroduce the substring 'injectable through RunSupervisorOptions'. [oracle: ! grep -q 'injectable through RunSupervisorOptions' test/supervisor/loop.test.ts && grep -q 'fixture-injectable' test/supervisor/loop.test.ts]

Dress rehearsal, run AFTER this story's commit (a worktree of HEAD only sees committed work): WT=$(mktemp -d)/wt && git worktree add "$WT" HEAD && perl -pi -e 's/^\[backend\]$/[backend]\nimplementer = "codex"/' "$WT/scripts/cam/project.toml" && (cd "$WT" && bun install --frozen-lockfile && HOME=$(mktemp -d) bun test); git worktree remove --force "$WT". The bun install step is mandatory (audit F-04): node_modules is gitignored (.gitignore:2) so a fresh worktree has no dependencies and the suite errors on 'Cannot find package' for a reason unrelated to the seam; note an emptied HOME also relocates Bun's install cache (~/.bun/install/cache) so an install run under it re-fetches (measured 2.5s), which is why the recipe installs with the real HOME and empties HOME only for the test run. Expected result: fail count drops from the measured baseline 85 to EXACTLY 11, none in loop.test.ts (residual: events 3, ensure-worker-pane 3, spawn-resolution 2, pause-halt 1, loop-model-resolution 1, pause-resume 1). Record before/after counts in handoff.json summary. [oracle: named-command, the recipe above with fail count = 11]

userStories.title: Plan-side dress rehearsal: prove the planner/auditor isolation under a codex-resolving live config
userStories.description: As a CI maintainer, I need a behavioral proof that the plan-side isolation holds when the live project.toml resolves planner and auditor to codex on an unauthenticated machine, since every plan-side presence grep is green-on-main by construction.
acceptanceCriteria: A fixture-vs-live distinguishability test is added to test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-configpath-seam.test.ts (issue AC10 cheap positive signal): using the generic claude fixture (no [models] section), assert the spawned planner argv carries 'opus' (DEFAULTS.planner, src/config/models.ts:62-70) and does NOT contain 'fable' (the live scripts/cam/project.toml pin), proving resolution went through the fixture. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-configpath-seam.test.ts && grep -q 'fable' test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-configpath-seam.test.ts]

Dress rehearsal, run after US-007/008/009 are committed: WT=$(mktemp -d)/wt && git worktree add "$WT" HEAD && perl -pi -e 's/^\[backend\]$/[backend]\nplanner = "codex"\nauditor = "codex"/' "$WT/scripts/cam/project.toml" && (cd "$WT" && bun install --frozen-lockfile && HOME=$(mktemp -d) bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner.test.ts test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-replan.test.ts test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-container.test.ts test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-auditor-payload.test.ts test/supervisor/plan/plan-sidecar-replan-wiring.test.ts test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-configpath-seam.test.ts test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-codex-auth.test.ts test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-model-resolution.test.ts test/supervisor/plan-runner.test.ts test/plan-runner-target-invalid.test.ts test/plan-runner-target-prompt.test.ts test/plan-runner-clear-stale.test.ts test/plan-runner-no-prd.test.ts test/plan-runner-in-progress-conflict.test.ts test/integration/plan-runner-target-obey.test.ts test/integration/plan-runner-no-prd.test.ts); git worktree remove --force "$WT". The bun install step is mandatory (audit F-04, gitignored node_modules). Expected result, scoped per audit F-05: the 14 isolated files are ALL green, and the total fail count is EXACTLY 3, confined to the two deliberate live-default files and matching these test names: 'AC4 - claude backend (repo default project.toml) -> codexAuthCheckFn never called' and 'absent codexAuthCheckFn + claude backend' (plan-runner-codex-auth.test.ts, 2 fails) and 'claude-backed dispatch (repo default project.toml) never invokes the injected cacheReader' (plan-runner-model-resolution.test.ts, 1 fail). These 3 fail BY DESIGN under the rehearsal flip because they assert the repo default resolves claude; the rehearsal never claims full greenness. Record before/after counts in handoff.json summary. [oracle: named-command, the recipe above with fail count = 3 in exactly the two named files]

The measured rehearsal result (file list, pass/fail counts, the 3 expected residual fails and why they are by-design) is persisted as a durable in-file dress-rehearsal comment in test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-configpath-seam.test.ts (handoff.json rotates and is banned as an evidence oracle, patterns.md:907-909; the token 'dress-rehearsal' measured absent repo-wide in test/ on main, so this grep is red on main). [oracle: grep -q 'dress-rehearsal' test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-configpath-seam.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Full quality spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-configpath-seam.test.ts only (plus handoff). This is the audit F-07 split: the dress rehearsal is its own final plan-side story instead of being appended to an unbounded file-sweep story. If the rehearsal measures anything other than exactly the 3 named residual fails, that is a missed isolation site: the failing file name localizes it; fix in place (it will be one of the 14 frozen-census files) rather than rationalizing the count. The [models.codex] section has no planner/auditor pins, so the rehearsal flip exercises the codex auto-resolution/preflight path exactly as CI would.

userStories.title: Re-commit implementer = codex and prove the suite green under a codex-unauthenticated environment
userStories.description: As the cam operator, I need [backend] implementer = "codex" restored in the committed project.toml (undoing revert ea72a1da) with acceptance evidence from a codex-unauthenticated run, so the proven-live codex implementer becomes committable config without breaking CI.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/cam/project.toml contains implementer = "codex" under [backend], restoring what ea72a1da removed (issue AC8; this story is sequenced LAST). Measured red on main: the only implementer assignment today is name-level claude plus the [models.codex] slug. [oracle: grep -q 'implementer = "codex"' scripts/cam/project.toml]

Pinning guard, labelled per patterns.md:899 (green on main by design, invariance claim): the pre-existing [models.codex] implementer = "gpt-5.6-sol" pin is untouched. [oracle: grep -q 'implementer = "gpt-5.6-sol"' scripts/cam/project.toml]

Issue AC9 dual-run acceptance evidence: BOTH runs recorded with pass/fail counts in handoff.json summary: (a) plain bun test on this codex-authenticated machine, and (b) HOME=$(mktemp -d) bun test (emptied HOME makes ~/.codex/auth.json unreadable; codexAuthCheck point-reads join(homedir(),'.codex','auth.json'), src/supervisor/codex-auth.ts:63, no env-var equivalent). Run (b) must show 0 fails; run (a) alone is EXPLICITLY NOT acceptance evidence (auditor measured 5630 pass / 0 fail on an unseamed flipped tree, making it tautological). No worktree is needed here: the working tree already has node_modules; the emptied HOME only affects the test run (and would relocate Bun's install cache if an install were run under it). [oracle: HOME=$(mktemp -d) bun test]

Issue AC11 repo-wide comment sweep: no test file still claims non-injectability through RunSupervisorOptions. The pattern is deliberately the SHORT wrap-safe one (audit F-01: the longer 'not injectable through RunSupervisorOptions' phrase is green on main because loop-model-resolution.test.ts wraps it at :132-133; the short pattern measured RED on main with 3 matches: loop-model-resolution:133, loop.test.ts:539, loop.test.ts:4246). [oracle: ! grep -rq 'injectable through RunSupervisorOptions' test/]

scripts/cam/patterns.md: the CAM-350 US-003 non-injectability bullet (patterns.md:877) is superseded: annotate it as superseded by CAM-420 and append a new bullet recording the fixture-injectable contract (RunSupervisorOptions.configPath and RunPlanPhaseOptions.configPath, the generic-fixture-default idiom, the explicit configPath: undefined opt-out) plus the measured AC9 dual-run evidence. Measured red on main: 0 occurrences of CAM-420 in patterns.md. [oracle: grep -q 'CAM-420' scripts/cam/patterns.md]

Pinning guard on the branch diff, labelled per patterns.md:899 and audit F-09 (green on an empty diff by construction; regression guard, not a new-behavior claim), widened from the two new files to everything this PRD touched: no line ADDED by this branch introduces skipIf into test/. [oracle: ! (git diff main...HEAD -- test/ | grep '^+' | grep -q 'skipIf')]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]

Full quality spine passes (bun run check:all; CI runs this on codex-unauthenticated runners per .github/workflows/ci.yml:26, which is the environment the emptied-HOME run simulates). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: scripts/cam/project.toml, scripts/cam/patterns.md. Under this flip the plan-side live-default tests (plan-runner-codex-auth, plan-runner-model-resolution) stay green: they read the planner/auditor phases, which still resolve claude ([backend] gains only implementer = "codex"; readPhaseBackend falls through name-level claude for other phases). Pre-existing skipIf usage in loop.test.ts and the integration plan files is untouched history, which is why the guard is diff-scoped rather than a repo-wide absence grep (a repo-wide one would be red for pre-existing, out-of-scope reasons). Do not edit the out-of-scope stale comments at test/commands/run-model-resolution.test.ts:126 or test/supervisor/review.test.ts:358 (MakeReviewDispatchOptions wording, a CAM-405-era leftover): both are outside issue AC11's occurrence list; the review.test.ts one is noted in scope-proposal outOfScope for a follow-up filed on main.
